method: Paused Play mode, one Editor Step per captured frame; samples after Magica afterRenderingDelegate. BakeMesh(true) on the custom skin and a cloth-free ghost with identical bone transforms. Penetration is geometric surface depth, relative to that same animated ghost, without particle thickness.
